interpretation.observed: Node topic IDs and exact fill colors in per-course saved HTML; capture-log times and Git commit provenance.
interpretation.conditional_mapping: Palette, #graph root and zero stroke widths match the legacy public renderer. Numeric-case-1..5 refer only to numeric switch cases of its topic.repetition display field, conditional on that historical renderer being used.
interpretation.default_caveat: Dark default does not mean >=6: every truthy value unequal to numeric 1..5, including fractions or strings, reaches default. Gray supplies no numeric repetition constraint.
interpretation.state_caveat: April capture renderer version, learner identity and server mapping between display repetition and FIRe repNum/stability are not recorded. The newer renderer uses a different stability-to-HSL mapping and must not be inverted on these legacy colors.
interpretation.course_caveat: Capture script switches active course before loading /learn and saving #graph. Cross-course differences are preserved, not reconciled into a single learner state or treated as before/after transitions.
interpretation.time_caveat: Started/completed times bound the logging operation, not an authenticated answer or state timestamp; Git dates corroborate file provenance, not exact capture time. History completion times have no verified zone.
